_meta.purpose: Maps veraPDF rule IDs to repair scripts. Enables the agent to route directly to the correct fix without reasoning from scratch. Keys match the normalised specification/clause format output by parse_verapdf_summary.py.
_meta.normalisation: veraPDF Arlington profiles output 'ISO 14289-1:2014' as the specification string. parse_verapdf_summary.py normalises this to 'PDF/UA-1' so keys here always use the PDF/UA-1 prefix regardless of how veraPDF labels it.

confidence_levels.CONFIRMED: Verified on at least one real Montefiore job — outcome was PASS
confidence_levels.EXPECTED: Correct per ISO 14289-1 spec + veraPDF rule definitions — not yet confirmed on a Montefiore job
confidence_levels.MANUAL: Cannot be auto-repaired — requires human intervention or Acrobat Pro

_meta.repair_order_note: repair_order matches the mandatory sequence in AGENTS.md. Always apply repairs in ascending order. fix_table_headers.py (order 10) MUST be last — no saves may occur after it. fix_table_tagging.py (order 9) MUST run before fix_table_headers.py.

PDF/UA-1/5.description: Document does not conform to PDF/UA-1 — missing or incorrect pdfuaid identifier
PDF/UA-1/5.notes: Top-level conformance clause. Always fixed by setting pdfuaid:part=1, pdfuaid:amd=2005. Run first.

PDF/UA-1/6.2.description: Document must include a conforming PDF/UA identifier in XMP metadata (pdfuaid:part=1, pdfuaid:amd=2005)
PDF/UA-1/6.2.notes: Almost always needed on unremediated PDFs. Sets pdfuaid:part=1 and pdfuaid:amd=2005. Never set part=2.

PDF/UA-1/6.7.2.description: CIDSet in font descriptor is incomplete for subset-embedded font
PDF/UA-1/6.7.2.notes: Font descriptor only — no struct tree impact. Safe to run early.

PDF/UA-1/6.2.11.8.description: XMP metadata and document info dictionary are not in parity (Author, Creator, Producer mismatch)
PDF/UA-1/6.2.11.8.notes: Sets Author, Creator, Producer to 'Montefiore Einstein'. Run metadata_xmp_parity_audit.py after to verify. Run again after ALL repairs to confirm no subsequent script corrupted metadata.

PDF/UA-1/7.1-content-unmarked.description: Content is neither marked as Artifact nor tagged as real content
PDF/UA-1/7.1-content-unmarked.notes: Pass 2 of the two-script untagged-PDF sequence. Runs after fix_untagged_pdf.py. Verifies and hardens ParentTree connectivity by walking the struct tree, mapping (page, MCID) to struct elements, and rebuilding the ParentTree number tree. Also wraps any pages with no MCIDs as /Artifact. Accepts --out path.json for orchestrator integration. Use whenever a PDF has a struct tree but ParentTree is broken or incomplete (Acrobat-tagged PDFs, partial remediations, etc.).

PDF/UA-1/7.1-untagged.description: Document has no StructTreeRoot — document is not tagged at all
PDF/UA-1/7.1-untagged.notes: Pass 1 of the two-script untagged-PDF sequence. Uses pikepdf.parse_content_stream for token-level content stream manipulation. (1) Classifies blocks via PyMuPDF rawdict; (2) walks content streams tracking BDC/BMC depth; (3) wraps BT/ET groups at depth 0 with /Tag <</MCID N>> BDC ... EMC, reclassifies non-PDF/UA tags (e.g. /PlacedPDF, /OC) as /Artifact, leaves other content as Artifact wrappers; (4) builds Document > Sect+ > H/P/L/Figure struct tree with one Sect per H (satisfies 7.4.4); (5) /L elements use ISO 32000-1 Annex L structure: L > LI > LBody > [MCID]; (6) assigns /StructParents to pages and builds ParentTree; (7) sets /Tabs /S on pages with annotations (satisfies 7.18.3). Run fix_struct_content_marking.py immediately after for ParentTree verification. Must run FIRST (repair_order 0) before any other repair.

PDF/UA-1/7.18.5.description: Link annotation missing Contents description (testNumber 2) or not tagged with Link struct element (testNumber 1)
PDF/UA-1/7.18.5.notes: Two-part fix: (a) sets Contents on link annotations missing it, deriving from URI (http(s)/mailto with urldecode); (b) creates /Link struct elements with /OBJR children and registers in ParentTree via /StructParent. Uses pikepdf throughout. The earlier PyMuPDF-based version returned ALREADY_CORRECT without doing anything because page.annots() silently returns 0 annotations after our pikepdf saves.

PDF/UA-1/7.18.1.description: Annotation missing required Contents or enclosing structure element Alt
PDF/UA-1/7.18.1.notes: Co-occurs with 7.18.5. Same fix sets Contents on all link annotations.

PDF/UA-1/7.18.3.description: Annotation has non-standard attribute (typically missing /Tabs /S on page)
PDF/UA-1/7.18.3.notes: Was previously MANUAL. Now fixed automatically by fix_untagged_pdf.py which sets /Tabs /S on every page that has annotations. Resolved on MM-TEST2.

PDF/UA-1/7.1.description: Document-level conformance failures — covers tagged PDF, viewer preferences, language, and catalog requirements
PDF/UA-1/7.1.notes: Arlington profile reports all 7.1.x failures under the parent clause 7.1. Run both fix_pdfua_identifier.py (repair_order 1) and fix_metadata_xmp_parity.py (repair_order 2) when this rule fires — they together cover Marked, DisplayDocTitle, Lang, and XMP fields. Always pass --title, --subject, --keywords derived from document content.

PDF/UA-1/7.1-1.description: Document is not marked as tagged (Marked entry missing from Catalog)
PDF/UA-1/7.1-1.notes: Fix sets Marked=true in the document catalog. If the document has no struct tree at all, run fix_untagged_pdf.py first (repair_order 0) which also sets MarkInfo/Marked=true.

PDF/UA-1/7.1-2.description: Document language not set (Lang entry missing from Catalog)
PDF/UA-1/7.1-2.notes: Lang entry should be set to 'en-US' for English documents unless otherwise specified. fix_untagged_pdf.py also sets /Lang to 'en-US' when generating a new struct tree.

PDF/UA-1/7.1-3.description: Document title not set or DisplayDocTitle not set to true
PDF/UA-1/7.1-3.notes: Requires ViewerPreferences/DisplayDocTitle=true and a non-empty dc:title in XMP.

PDF/UA-1/7.2-1.description: Real content not tagged — content outside struct tree
PDF/UA-1/7.2-1.notes: Was previously MANUAL. fix_untagged_pdf.py now auto-tags untagged native-text PDFs. If document is image-only, still MANUAL (requires OCR first then retagging). Pre-flight OCR detection runs before this script.

PDF/UA-1/7.2.description: Natural language for text cannot be determined — missing /Lang on struct elements or document catalog
PDF/UA-1/7.2.notes: Two parts: (1) fix_metadata_xmp_parity.py sets /Lang in document catalog (repair_order 2); (2) fix_figure_alt_text.py sets /Lang on Figure struct elements alongside Alt (repair_order 6). Both must run. If 7.2 still fails after both, check that struct element Lang inheritance is not broken by subsequent saves.

PDF/UA-1/7.3.description: Figure element missing Alt attribute or has placeholder alt text
PDF/UA-1/7.3.notes: Check for alt_map_approved.json first (Branch A). If exists, apply directly. If not, run generate_alt_text_drafts.py then pause for human review (Branch B). Never apply placeholder text to production output.

PDF/UA-1/7.3-1.description: Figure element missing Alt attribute (no alternate text)
PDF/UA-1/7.3-1.notes: Requires human-approved alt_map_approved.json. Run generate_alt_text_drafts.py then generate_alt_text_review_report.py first. Never apply auto-placeholder text to production output. Figures marked decorative receive empty Alt.

PDF/UA-1/7.3-3.description: Figure element has empty or meaningless Alt text (placeholder detected)
PDF/UA-1/7.3-3.notes: Same workflow as 7.3-1. Human review gate required.

PDF/UA-1/7.4.4.description: Each node in the tag tree shall contain at most one child H tag
PDF/UA-1/7.4.4.notes: fix_untagged_pdf.py creates a new Sect element for each H so that no Sect has more than one H child. Confirmed resolved on MM-TEST2. If document already has a struct tree where multiple H's are siblings, a separate fix_heading_hierarchy.py would be needed (not yet implemented).

ISO_32000-1/Annex_L_888.description: L (List) struct element must not contain content item kid directly
ISO_32000-1/Annex_L_888.notes: ISO 32000-1 Annex L test 888: L elements must use proper hierarchy L > LI > LBody > [MCID]. fix_untagged_pdf.py now builds this structure correctly with the MCID assigned to LBody, not L. Confirmed on MM-TEST2.

PDF/UA-1/7.5-1.notes: MUST RUN LAST. TH Scope xrefs are invalidated by any subsequent save or pikepdf operation. No PDF writes may occur after this script.

PDF/UA-1/7.5-2.description: Table header scope is incorrect or inconsistent
PDF/UA-1/7.5-2.notes: Same constraint as 7.5-1 — must run last.

PDF/UA-1/7.6-1.notes: Sets ListNumbering on L elements. Run before fix_parent_tree_mcids and fix_table_headers.

PDF/UA-1/7.18.1-1.description: Annotation missing Contents entry (link has no accessible description)
PDF/UA-1/7.18.1-1.notes: Adds Contents key to Link annotations. Run after alt text, before list and table repairs.

PDF/UA-1/7.18.3-1.description: Widget annotation not tagged or missing struct tree entry
PDF/UA-1/7.18.3-1.notes: Form widget tagging is complex. Flag for human review. May require Acrobat Pro remediation.

PDF/UA-1/7.21.3-1.notes: Check font_inventory.py + font_geometry_matcher.py first for geometry match. Font replacement is last resort. If no geometry match available, escalate — cannot auto-repair.

PDF/UA-1/7.21.4.2.description: CIDSet entry in font descriptor is incomplete for subset font
PDF/UA-1/7.21.4.2.notes: MUST run AFTER all PyMuPDF saves. PyMuPDF garbage=4 rewrite regenerates font descriptors and restores CIDSet entries. Running fix_cidset last among non-table repairs ensures removal is not undone. Uses pikepdf — safe from PyMuPDF interference after this point.

PDF/UA-1/7.21.4.2-1.description: CIDSet entry in font descriptor is incomplete for subset font
PDF/UA-1/7.21.4.2-1.notes: Older veraPDF profile variant of 7.21.4.2. Same fix applies.

PDF/UA-1/7.21.6-1.description: .notdef glyph rendered — font has missing glyph mappings
PDF/UA-1/7.21.6-1.notes: Font-level fix, no struct tree impact. Run before any struct tree repairs.

WCAG-2-2-Machine/1.4.3.description: Text contrast ratio below 4.5:1 (WCAG AA minimum)
WCAG-2-2-Machine/1.4.3.notes: Run contrast_audit.py first to identify affected runs. Fix adjusts color values in content streams. No struct tree impact.

WCAG-2-2-Machine/1.1.1.notes: WCAG mirror of PDF/UA-1/7.3-1. Same repair script and human review gate apply.

table_semantics/untagged_tables.description: Visual tables detected by pdfplumber that have no corresponding Table struct element. Confirmed by vision model before tagging.
table_semantics/untagged_tables.notes: NOT triggered by a veraPDF rule — injected by remediate.py when table_semantics_audit.py reports untagged_table_pages (after geometry + vision false-positive filtering). Uses pdfplumber for geometric detection, NIM vision model to confirm candidates and identify header rows, then restructures existing MCIDs into Table > TR > TH|TD hierarchy via pikepdf. Must run BEFORE fix_table_headers.py (repair_order 10) which adds Scope to TH cells this script creates. repair_order 9 ensures it runs after fix_cidset.py and before fix_table_headers.py. Confirmed on MM-TEST2: 1 table tagged, 7 false positives rejected, zero new veraPDF failures introduced.

manual_escalation_triggers: Image-only page detected — OCR required before any repair
Corrupt xref table — qpdf repair failed
agent_usage_instructions: At the start of each job, after running parse_verapdf_summary.py, look up each failing rule_id in this map. For each match: (a) record the repair_script and repair_order, (b) sort all required repairs by repair_order ascending, (c) flag any rule with repair_script=null for MANUAL escalation, (d) confirm fix_table_headers.py (if needed) is always last. Execute repairs in order. If a rule_id is not in this map, reason from AGENTS.md rules and document the outcome in STATUS.json so the map can be updated.
